name: qa-cache-testing
description: Cache testing across browser, CDN, proxy, application and data-store layers: Redis, CDN purges, Varnish VTC tests, and cache-key collision audits. Covers RFC 9111 HTTP caching, Cloudflare / Fastly / CloudFront purge APIs, browser Cache-Control tests, and cache-coherence patterns with stampede and stale-while-revalidate references. A detector agent (cache-key-collision-detector) finds keys missing a tenant, user or locale discriminator.
